description: Fill saved username and password fields in a supervised session without returning credential values. etld_plus_one identifies the saved credential site and must match the target page, including private suffixes. Requires agent control; frame targeting is refused. Optional selectors override the default username/email and password inputs.

etld_plus_one.description: The saved credential site, for example example.com or alice.github.io.

frame.description: Frame targeting is refused for credential fills; use the main page.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

password_selector.description: CSS selector for the password input. Defaults to current-password/password inputs.

username_selector.description: CSS selector for the username input. Defaults to username/email inputs.

name: fill_credential
title: Fill saved credential
